`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module arbiter #(
    parameter PORTS = 4,
    parameter ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK_ACK = 1,
    parameter ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [PORTS-1:0] request,
    input wire [PORTS-1:0] acknowledge,
    output wire [PORTS-1:0] grant,
    output wire grant_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded
);

reg [PORTS-1:0] grant_reg, grant_next;
reg grant_valid_reg, grant_valid_next;
reg [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded_reg, grant_encoded_next;
reg [PORTS-1:0] mask_reg, mask_next;

assign grant = grant_reg;
assign grant_valid = grant_valid_reg;
assign grant_encoded = grant_encoded_reg;

wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request = request & mask_reg;
wire request_valid = |request;
wire masked_request_valid = |masked_request;
wire [PORTS-1:0] request_winner;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request_winner;
wire [PORTS-1:0] request_thermometer;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request_thermometer;

genvar g;
generate
    for (g = 0; g < PORTS; g = g+1) begin : priority_bits
        if (ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : low_priority_first
            if (g == 0) begin : edge_bit
                assign request_winner[g] = request[g];
                assign masked_request_winner[g] = masked_request[g];
                assign request_thermometer[g] = 1'b0;
                assign masked_request_thermometer[g] = 1'b0;
            end else begin : interior_bit
                assign request_winner[g] = request[g] & ~(|request[g-1:0]);
                assign masked_request_winner[g] = masked_request[g] & ~(|masked_request[g-1:0]);
                assign request_thermometer[g] = |request[g-1:0];
                assign masked_request_thermometer[g] = |masked_request[g-1:0];
            end
        end else begin : high_priority_first
            if (g == PORTS-1) begin : edge_bit
                assign request_winner[g] = request[g];
                assign masked_request_winner[g] = masked_request[g];
                assign request_thermometer[g] = 1'b0;
                assign masked_request_thermometer[g] = 1'b0;
            end else begin : interior_bit
                assign request_winner[g] = request[g] & ~(|request[PORTS-1:g+1]);
                assign masked_request_winner[g] = masked_request[g] & ~(|masked_request[PORTS-1:g+1]);
                assign request_thermometer[g] = |request[PORTS-1:g+1];
                assign masked_request_thermometer[g] = |masked_request[PORTS-1:g+1];
            end
        end
    end
endgenerate

/* Encode by parallel OR planes, rather than a priority-multiplexer tree. */
localparam INDEX_BITS = $clog2(PORTS) > 0 ? $clog2(PORTS) : 2;
localparam ENCODER_LEVELS = PORTS > 2 ? $clog2(PORTS) : 1;
wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] request_index_raw;
wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] masked_request_index_raw;
genvar b, k;
generate
    for (b = 0; b < INDEX_BITS; b = b+1) begin : encode_bits
        wire [PORTS-1:0] req_terms;
        wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_terms;
        for (k = 0; k < PORTS; k = k+1) begin : terms
            if ((k >> b) & 1) begin : included
                assign req_terms[k] = request_winner[k];
                assign masked_terms[k] = masked_request_winner[k];
            end else begin : excluded
                assign req_terms[k] = 1'b0;
                assign masked_terms[k] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        assign request_index_raw[b] = |req_terms;
        assign masked_request_index_raw[b] = |masked_terms;
    end
endgenerate

/* Preserve the reference encoder's defined invalid-input values. */
wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] request_index = request_valid ? request_index_raw :
    (ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY ? (2**ENCODER_LEVELS-1) : 0);
wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] masked_request_index = masked_request_valid ? masked_request_index_raw :
    (ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY ? (2**ENCODER_LEVELS-1) : 0);
wire [PORTS-1:0] request_mask = 1 << request_index;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request_mask = 1 << masked_request_index;

always @* begin
    grant_next = 0;
    grant_valid_next = 0;
    grant_encoded_next = 0;
    mask_next = mask_reg;

    if (ARB_BLOCK && !ARB_BLOCK_ACK && (|(grant_reg & request))) begin
        grant_next = grant_reg;
        grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
        grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
    end else if (ARB_BLOCK && ARB_BLOCK_ACK && grant_valid_reg && !(|(grant_reg & acknowledge))) begin
        grant_next = grant_reg;
        grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
        grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
    end else if (request_valid) begin
        grant_valid_next = 1'b1;
        if (ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN && masked_request_valid) begin
            grant_next = masked_request_winner;
            grant_encoded_next = masked_request_index_raw;
            mask_next = masked_request_thermometer;
        end else begin
            grant_next = request_winner;
            grant_encoded_next = request_index_raw;
            if (ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN)
                mask_next = request_thermometer;
        end
    end
end

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (rst) begin
        grant_reg <= 0;
        grant_valid_reg <= 0;
        grant_encoded_reg <= 0;
        mask_reg <= 0;
    end else begin
        grant_reg <= grant_next;
        grant_valid_reg <= grant_valid_next;
        grant_encoded_reg <= grant_encoded_next;
        mask_reg <= mask_next;
    end
end

endmodule
`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The reference computes two priority-encoded indices, decodes them back to one-hot grants, and derives the round-robin mask through index-dependent arithmetic and shifting. This creates avoidable serial logic between mask_reg and the registered grant/mask outputs. The supplied mapped paths demonstrate substantial combinational depth but do not uniquely identify its source.",
  "rewrite": "Compute masked and unmasked one-hot winners directly with parallel priority reductions. Encode the winners with OR planes. Compute each next-mask bit directly from a prefix or suffix request reduction: for MSB priority, bit i is set exactly when a request above i exists; for LSB priority, it is set exactly when a request below i exists. Select between the two candidates using the original masked-request-valid condition. Retain the original named state registers and hold/reset decision order. The design is self-contained and requires no helper modules.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to improve setup WNS by removing the encode-to-decode path and, especially, the encoded-index-to-variable-shift mask path. The remaining principal paths are priority reductions, OR-plane encoding, and hold/candidate selection. No synthesis or STA run was available here, so a numerical gain or a passing result is not claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Parallel reductions can trade some replicated combinational logic and request fanout for reduced logic depth. Synthesis can share overlapping reductions. Register count and state encodings are unchanged, and there is no added latency. Compliance with the 4855.656960 um2 area cap and electrical limits requires evaluation with the specified mapping flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves synchronous active-high reset, registered outputs, blocking-on-acknowledge behavior, request-deassert blocking mode, fixed-priority mode, both priority directions, idle output clearing, and mask retention while idle or blocked. The direct thermometer equations equal the reference shifts whenever a valid winner is selected. Named encoder-result wires retain the reference's invalid-input defaults, while state updates use valid winners only. No initialization, startup assumptions, new state, latches, memories, generated clocks, assertions, or undefined outputs are introduced. Formal and mapped equivalence remain to be checked under the stated reset-first-sample contract."
}
